selection: First complete JSONL row in each of 3 tasks x 8 lanes; independently checked against first frozen-manifest lane entry; no success-based selection or replacement.
row_hash_encoding: SHA256 of exact first JSONL record bytes including trailing newline; not the growing whole JSONL file.
comparison: raw sensor SHA with shape/dtype/all channels; dynamic state atol1e-6

audit_starts_return.comparison: raw sensor SHA with shape/dtype/all channels; dynamic state atol1e-6
audit_starts_return.scope: initial pairing only; not student performance or generalization

limitations: Only the declared 24 initial pairs, not full4215 coverage, media audit, final SR or generalization.
Student recorded raw-sensor SHA includes shape, dtype and all sensor channels; persisted teacher PNGs contain RGB only and are compared pixelwise to one another, not equated with a raw RGBA hash.
Dynamic-state comparison uses atol1e-6 and rtol0; state digests are provenance, not a replacement for tolerant numeric comparison.
Reading and SHA-checking the pinned full teacher index does not constitute re-auditing all4215 teacher trajectories; only144 evidence files for24 selected pairs were verified.
Contains individual success/status solely to prove outcome-independent sampling; no final aggregate SR claim.
Read-only CPU audit; no GPU, checkpoint load, simulator reset/render, task changes or writes to running evaluation roots.
